description: Vue 3 + TypeScript UI component library with layout components, configurable props and shared themes for business interfaces.
rules: Import public components and types from @x-soft88/x-ui, and import @x-soft88/x-ui/style.css once in the application.
Prefer X.UI components, layout props and the regular/dark/light themes to handwritten CSS; add CSS only for capabilities the library does not provide.
Read the documented props, events, slots, defaults and exported types before generating code. Never invent components, props or features.
Use numeric fontSize in px; configure height independently. Verify responsive behavior for the specific component.
Vue peer dependency is ^3.5.0. Current package publishing configuration is restricted; do not assume anonymous npm installation is available.
